availability.gate: Reject entry when signed16 record selection != -1. The project menu presents all18 rows; this path does not gate by town population.

costs.base: trunc(i32(sum for width*height cells of signed8 descriptor attribute*1000000)/10)
costs.site: trunc(i32(signed land total + FULL demolition total)/10)
costs.demolition: Count each intersecting original building once at full footprint*attribute*1000000, using first72 native tile-range descriptors. Whole-footprint demolition can extend beyond the chosen rectangle.
costs.budget: Menu first accepts cash>=base. Site confirm requires site < i32(cash-base), so cash==total is rejected on these non-overflow source inputs.
costs.payment: Temporarily subtract base for site UI, restore cash on return. On success post full amount once through 0x8001cbc4 with first-store pointer0x8012b2f8; use its flags bit15 to choose company cash/capital ledger. Cancellation leaves cash unchanged.

siting.category3_housing49: If mask16 set, accept only source tile in descriptor43.lower..48.upper. Existing kind49 does not qualify.
siting.categories6to8: If mask16 set, only existing category3..5 may be replaced.
siting.distance: No native nearby-distance search is invoked by quote; the natural monthly-growth facility radius rule must not be added to project quote.
siting.cursor_edge: Quote first shifts drawn rectangle inside map, but feasibility checks original x,y. An out-of-bounds original footprint remains invalid; invalid quote leaves old demolition/display/mask values in globals and sets land=-1. Confirm checks that sentinel.

record_fields.30: signed16 sound comparison threshold, not initialized here

start.countdown: RNG%5+4, stored u16. One further random mix choice per modified cell, including otherwise deterministic empty/reserved cells.
start.town: For each selected cell, place kind71 誘致用地(tile521, category10), mode0. Positive-category buildings are demolished as whole footprints. Preserve land coefficient byte+2; write attribute/category/tile/mix and mask bits24 via source placement.

completion.clock: Only hour==0 and subhour==0. No day-of-month condition. Tick unsigned16(countdown-1), complete only on zero. Starting from0 underflows65535.
completion.town: Clear each reserved cell using kind12 空き地 mode0, then place selected complete building at rectangle origin. Each footprint cell chooses one of five customer mixes independently; preserve duplicate weights and signed bytes.
completion.record: Set signed16 selection=-1; other record bytes persist.
completion.notification: Text prefix0x800992d8 + MSG[98+i16(0x80098768+kind*2)] + suffix0x800992ec; queue type2, descriptor event field+52, flags1/0.
completion.sound: 29 or34 depends on comparison of uninitialized completion stack[fp+0x1c] with record i16+30. Preserve as unresolved input; do not assign a stable facility-specific sound.
completion.scheduling: Caller0x80023438 invokes project completion before daily close and later natural monthly town growth. A finished building is available to following processing at that midnight.

save.note: Original payload compatibility fact, not a requirement to implement PS1 memory cards on Android.

unknown: Raw project fields+2,+4,+6,+8,+16 are retained without semantic labels.
Static source maps are not post-play observations; no new APK in this data extraction.
